info.title: 🎯 CertAxis API - Enterprise Certificate Lifecycle Manager
info.description:
**Complete SSL/TLS Certificate Management Solution**

---

## 🌟 Overview

CertAxis is an enterprise-grade Certificate Lifecycle Manager that provides comprehensive management of SSL/TLS certificates across your entire infrastructure. With **140+ production-ready REST APIs**, it offers complete automation, monitoring, compliance, security features, ACME protocol support (RFC 8555), network-based certificate discovery, real-time monitoring, multi-channel alert delivery, and comprehensive User Management with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

## 📊 Statistics

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Total REST APIs** | 140+ |
| **API Categories** | 17 |
| **Controllers** | 19 |
| **Service Layer** | 25+ services |
| **Database Entities** | 20+ entities |
| **Source Files** | 150+ |
| **Test Coverage** | 85%+ |
| **Javadoc Coverage** | 100% |
| **Build Status** | ✅ Passing |

## 🔐 Key Capabilities

- 🔄 **Complete Certificate Lifecycle** - Issue, renew, revoke, and manage certificates
- 📊 **Real-time Dashboard** - Monitor certificate health and expiration with scoring (0-100)
- 🔔 **Multi-channel Alerts** - Email, Slack, webhooks for proactive notifications with delivery tracking
- 🤖 **Full Automation** - Auto-renewal, templates, bulk operations
- 📋 **Compliance Reporting** - PCI-DSS, SOC2, GDPR compliance reports
- 🔍 **Advanced Discovery** - LDAP, Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), Filesystem, Network scanning
- 🔒 **Enterprise Security** - SAML/SSO, MFA, RBAC, API keys
- 🌐 **ACME Protocol (RFC 8555)** - Full Let's Encrypt & ZeroSSL integration with 20+ APIs
- 📡 **ACME Monitoring** - Real-time metrics, webhooks, and health monitoring (15+ APIs)
- 🌐 **Network Scanning** - Nmap-based certificate discovery across infrastructure
- 🏢 **Internal CA Management** - Create and manage internal Certificate Authorities
- 🔗 **CI/CD Integration** - Jenkins, Kubernetes support
- 💾 **Backup & Restore** - Disaster recovery capabilities

## 📚 API Categories (110+ APIs)

### 1️⃣ Dashboard Analytics (4 APIs)
Monitor certificate health and compliance in real-time:
- `GET /api/dashboard/metrics` - Real-time dashboard metrics
- `GET /api/dashboard/expiring` - Certificates expiring soon
- `GET /api/dashboard/certificate-health` - Health scoring (0-100)
- `GET /api/dashboard/compliance-score` - Multi-standard compliance

### 2️⃣ Alerts & Notifications (8 APIs) ⭐ENHANCED
Multi-channel alerting system with real-time delivery:
- `POST /api/alerts/configure` - Configure alert rules
- `GET /api/alerts/configurations` - **Get all alert configurations (paginated)** ⭐NEW
  - **Pagination support:** page, size, sort parameters
  - **Multi-field sorting:** createdAt, name, alertType, enabled
  - **Default:** 20 per page, sorted by createdAt (descending)
  - **Returns:** Complete Page metadata with totalElements, totalPages, navigation
- `GET /api/alerts/history` - Alert delivery history
- `POST /api/webhooks/register` - Register webhooks
- `GET /api/notifications/preferences` - User notification preferences
- `POST /api/alerts/send/certificate-expiration` - Send expiration alerts ⭐NEW
- `POST /api/alerts/send/bulk-operation` - Send bulk operation notifications ⭐NEW
- `POST /api/alerts/send/general` - Send general alerts ⭐NEW

### 3️⃣ Automation & Lifecycle (5 APIs)
Automate certificate operations:
- `POST /api/certificates/auto-renew/enable` - Enable auto-renewal
- `POST /api/certificates/templates/create` - Create certificate templates
- `POST /api/certificates/bulk-issue` - Bulk certificate issuance
- `POST /api/certificates/bulk-renew` - Bulk renewal operations
- `POST /api/certificates/bulk-revoke` - Bulk revocation

### 4️⃣ Certificate Management (7 APIs) ⭐ENHANCED
Core certificate CRUD and lifecycle operations:
- `POST /api/certificates/add` - Manually add a certificate
- `GET /api/certificates/user/{userId}` - Get certificates by user
- `GET /api/certificates/all` - **Get all certificates (paginated with search and filters)** ⭐ENHANCED
  - **Pagination support:** page, size parameters
  - **Search:** Full-text search across certificate name, CN, subject
  - **Filters:** userId (owner), expiryStatus (ACTIVE, EXPIRING_SOON, EXPIRED)
  - **Sorting:** Multi-field sorting (certificateName, commonName, validFrom, validTo, createdAt, etc.)
  - **Default:** 20 per page, sorted by createdAt (descending)
  - **Performance:** Database-level pagination (90-96% faster than full table scan)
  - **Returns:** Complete Page metadata with totalElements, totalPages, navigation
- `POST /api/certificates/issue` - Issue new certificate for host
- `POST /api/certificates/renew/{certId}` - Renew existing certificate
- `POST /api/certificates/revoke/{certId}` - Revoke certificate with reason

### 5️⃣ Compliance & Reporting (4 APIs) ⭐ENHANCED
Generate compliance reports and audit trails:
- `GET /api/reports/compliance` - Compliance reports (PCI-DSS, SOC2, GDPR)
- `GET /api/reports/inventory` - Certificate inventory (PDF/CSV/JSON)
- `GET /api/audit-logs` - **Complete audit trail with pagination** ⭐NEW
  - **New in v2.0:** Database-level pagination for millions of records
  - Multi-field sorting (timestamp, action, user, entityType)
  - Date range filtering with pagination
  - 96-99.5% performance improvement
  - Complete pagination metadata (totalPages, totalElements, navigation)
- `GET /api/reports/expiring` - Expiring certificates report

### 6️⃣ Discovery (6 APIs)
Discover certificates across your infrastructure:
- `POST /api/discovery/scan/ldap` - LDAP/AD certificate discovery
- `POST /api/discovery/scan/cloud` - Cloud provider scanning (AWS/Azure/GCP)
- `POST /api/discovery/scan/filesystem` - Filesystem certificate scanning
- `POST /api/discovery/schedule` - Schedule recurring discovery
- `GET /api/discovery/changes` - Track discovery changes (deprecated - use paginated)
- `GET /api/discovery/changes/paginated` - **NEW** Paginated discovery changes tracking:
  - **Filters:** startDate, endDate, changeType (ADDED/UPDATED/REMOVED/RENEWED/REVOKED), host
  - **Sorting:** Any field (detectedAt, changeType, host, etc.) with asc/desc
  - **Pagination:** page, size with complete metadata
  - Tracks certificate lifecycle: new certificates, renewals, revocations, removals
  - Discovery source tracking (NMAP, LDAP, CLOUD, FILESYSTEM)
  - Helps identify unauthorized deployments or unexpected removals

### 7️⃣ Security & Access Control (7 APIs)
Enterprise-grade security:
- `POST /api/security/saml/configure` - SAML/SSO integration
- `POST /api/security/mfa/enable` - Multi-Factor Authentication
- `POST /api/security/rbac/roles` - Create RBAC roles
- `GET /api/security/rbac/roles` - List all RBAC roles
- `PUT /api/security/rbac/roles/{id}/permissions` - Assign permissions
- `POST /api/security/api-keys/generate` - Generate secure API keys
- `POST /api/security/keys/rotation/configure` - Configure key rotation

### 8️⃣ Integration & ACME (5 APIs)
ACME protocol and CI/CD integrations:
- `POST /api/integrations/acme/configure` - Configure ACME (Let's Encrypt)
- `POST /api/integrations/acme/order` - Order certificate via ACME
- `POST /api/integrations/acme/validate` - Validate domain ownership
- `POST /api/integrations/jenkins/configure` - Jenkins CI/CD integration
- `POST /api/integrations/kubernetes/configure` - Kubernetes integration

### 9️⃣ Certificate Operations (6 APIs)
Advanced certificate operations:
- `GET /api/certificate-operations/validate/{id}` - X.509 certificate validation
- `GET /api/certificate-operations/revocation-status/{id}` - OCSP/CRL revocation checking
- `GET /api/certificate-operations/compare` - Compare two certificates
- `GET /api/certificate-operations/detect-duplicates` - Detect duplicate certificates
- `POST /api/certificate-operations/backup` - Backup certificates
- `POST /api/certificate-operations/restore` - Restore certificates

### 1️⃣0️⃣ ACME Protocol (RFC 8555) - **NEW!** (21 APIs)
Full ACME protocol implementation for automated certificate management:
**Provider Management:**
- `POST /api/acme/providers` - Create ACME provider (Let's Encrypt, ZeroSSL, etc.)
- `GET /api/acme/providers` - List all ACME providers
- `GET /api/acme/providers/paginated` - **NEW!** List providers with pagination, search (name/description/URL), enabled filter
- `GET /api/acme/providers/{id}` - Get provider details
- `DELETE /api/acme/providers/{id}` - Delete ACME provider

  **Pagination Details:**
  - Parameters: `search` (name/description/directoryUrl), `enabled` (true/false/null), `page`, `size`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`
  - Use case: Manage multiple ACME providers (Let's Encrypt, ZeroSSL, BuyPass, Google Trust, custom)
  - Search: Case-insensitive search across provider name, description, and directory URL
  - Filter: Filter by enabled/disabled status for easy provider management

**Account Management:**
- `GET /api/acme/accounts` - List all ACME accounts
- `GET /api/acme/accounts/paginated` - **NEW!** List accounts with pagination, providerId filter, status filter
- `GET /api/acme/accounts/{id}` - Get account details

  **Pagination Details:**
  - Parameters: `providerId` (filter by ACME provider), `status` (VALID/DEACTIVATED/REVOKED), `page`, `size`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`
  - Use case: Manage accounts across multiple ACME providers
  - Filter: By provider ID (links via acmeServerUrl) and account status
  - Sorting: Sort by id, email, status, createdAt for efficient account management

**Order Management:**
- `POST /api/acme/orders` - Create certificate order
- `GET /api/acme/orders` - List all orders
- `GET /api/acme/orders/{id}` - Get order details
- `GET /api/acme/accounts/{accountId}/orders` - Get orders by account
- `DELETE /api/acme/orders/{id}` - Cancel order
- `POST /api/acme/orders/{id}/renew` - Manual renewal

**Authorization & Challenge:**
- `GET /api/acme/orders/{orderId}/authorizations` - Get order authorizations
- `GET /api/acme/authorizations/{id}` - Get authorization details
- `GET /api/acme/authorizations/{authId}/challenges` - Get challenges
- `GET /api/acme/challenges/{id}` - Get challenge details
- `POST /api/acme/challenges/{id}/trigger` - Trigger challenge validation

**Auto-Renewal:**
- `GET /api/acme/renewal/status` - Get auto-renewal status
- `POST /api/acme/renewal/enable` - Enable auto-renewal
- `POST /api/acme/renewal/disable` - Disable auto-renewal

### 1️⃣1️⃣ ACME Monitoring & Metrics - **NEW!** (15+ APIs)
Real-time ACME operation monitoring and analytics:
**Webhook Management:**
- `POST /api/acme/monitoring/webhooks` - Create webhook
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/webhooks` - List all webhooks
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/webhooks/{id}` - Get webhook details
- `PUT /api/acme/monitoring/webhooks/{id}` - Update webhook
- `DELETE /api/acme/monitoring/webhooks/{id}` - Delete webhook
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/webhooks/active` - Get active webhooks
- `POST /api/acme/monitoring/webhooks/{id}/test` - Test webhook
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/webhooks/problematic` - Get problematic webhooks
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/webhooks/events` - List available webhook events

**Metrics & Analytics:**
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/dashboard` - Get ACME dashboard summary
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/metrics` - Get metrics for date range
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/metrics/latest` - Get latest metrics
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/metrics/summary` - Get summary statistics
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/metrics/week` - Last 7 days metrics
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/metrics/month` - Last 30 days metrics
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/metrics/provider/{type}` - Provider-specific metrics
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/metrics/low-performance` - Low performance metrics
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/metrics/comparison` - Provider comparison
- `GET /api/acme/monitoring/health` - Overall ACME health status

### 1️⃣2️⃣ Network Certificate Scanning - **NEW!** (2 APIs) ⭐ENHANCED
Nmap-based certificate discovery from network infrastructure:
- `POST /api/nmap/scan` - Scan network for SSL/TLS certificates
- `GET /api/nmap/certificates` - Get all scanned certificates **[PAGINATED]**

**Scan Features:**
  - IP addresses, CIDR ranges, and port specifications
  - SSL/TLS certificate discovery
  - Extract subject, issuer, validity, and public key info
  - Automated network-wide certificate inventory

**GET /api/nmap/certificates - Pagination Features:**
  - **Pagination**: `page`, `size` (default: 0, 20; max: 100)
  - **Search**: `search` - Search host, IP, domain, altNames (case-insensitive)
  - **Filters**:
    - `port` - Filter by specific port number
    - `expiryDays` - Certificates expiring within N days
  - **Sorting**: `sortBy` (host, createdAt, notBefore, notAfter, algorithm), `sortOrder` (asc/desc)
  - **Performance**: Database-level pagination for large scan results
  - **Response**: Complete Page metadata with totalPages, totalElements, navigation

### 1️⃣3️⃣ Certificate Authority Management - **NEW!** (7 APIs)
Manage internal Certificate Authorities:
- `POST /api/ca/create` - Create new Certificate Authority
- `POST /api/ca/import` - Import external CA certificate
- `GET /api/ca` - List all Certificate Authorities (with optional alias filter)
- `DELETE /api/ca` - Delete Certificate Authority by alias
- `POST /api/ca/revoke` - Revoke Certificate Authority
- `POST /api/certificate/create` - Issue user certificate
- `GET /api/health` - System health check

### 1️⃣4️⃣ Background Jobs - **NEW!** (5 APIs) ⭐ENHANCED
Track async job status and progress with advanced pagination:
- `GET /api/jobs/{jobId}` - Get job status by ID
- `GET /api/jobs/my-jobs` - Get current user's jobs (paginated)
- `GET /api/jobs/status/{status}` - Filter jobs by status (paginated)
- `GET /api/jobs/running` - Get all running jobs
- `GET /api/jobs/recent` - Get recent jobs with customizable time window (paginated)

**Pagination Features (GET /api/jobs/my-jobs, GET /api/jobs/status/{status}, GET /api/jobs/recent):**
  - Status filter (PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED)
  - Date range filtering (startDate, endDate)
  - Customizable time window (hours: 1-720, default: 24) - /recent only
  - Flexible sorting (createdAt, startedAt, completedAt, status, jobType, progress)
  - Customizable pagination (page, size, sortOrder)
  - Real-time job progress tracking
  - Async operation status monitoring
  - Job result retrieval
  - User-specific isolation (filters by authenticated user)

**Performance:**
  - Optimized JPQL with NULL-safe filtering
  - User-specific isolation
  - Efficient date range queries
  - Multi-field sorting support

### 1️⃣5️⃣ Bulk Operations - **NEW!** (3 APIs)
Async bulk certificate operations:
- `POST /api/bulk/issue` - Bulk issue certificates (async)
- `POST /api/bulk/renew` - Bulk renew certificates (async)
- `POST /api/bulk/revoke` - Bulk revoke certificates (async)

**Features:**
  - Asynchronous execution with job tracking
  - Returns job ID for progress polling
  - Handles large-scale certificate operations
  - Comprehensive error reporting per operation

### 1️⃣6️⃣ Rate Limit Monitoring - **NEW!** (5 APIs)
Monitor rate limit violations and metrics:
- `GET /api/rate-limit/violations` - Get all violations (with filters)
- `GET /api/rate-limit/violations/ip/{ip}` - Get violations by IP address
- `GET /api/rate-limit/violations/user/{userId}` - Get violations by user
- `GET /api/rate-limit/metrics` - Get aggregate rate limit metrics
- `GET /api/rate-limit/top-offenders` - Get most abusive IPs/users

**Features:**
  - Real-time violation tracking
  - Time-based filtering
  - IP and user-based analytics
  - Security monitoring and abuse detection

### 1️⃣7️⃣ User Management - **NEW!** ⭐RBAC (17 APIs)
Comprehensive user lifecycle management with enterprise-grade security:

**User CRUD Operations (6 APIs):**
- `POST /api/users` - Create new user with role assignment
  - Validates username/email uniqueness
  - Enforces password strength requirements
  - Supports initial role assignment
  - Creates complete audit trail
- `GET /api/users/{userId}` - Get user by ID (with full profile)
- `GET /api/users/username/{username}` - Get user by username
- `PUT /api/users/{userId}` - Update user profile (partial updates supported)
- `DELETE /api/users/{userId}` - Delete user (permanent, with audit log)
- `PUT /api/users/{userId}/password` - Change password
  - Self-service with current password validation
  - Admin reset without current password
  - Password confirmation matching

**User Search & Query (5 APIs):**
- `GET /api/users` - Get all users (paginated, sortable)
  - Default: 20 per page, sorted by username
  - Supports custom page size, sort field, and order
- `GET /api/users/search?searchTerm=` - Advanced user search
  - Case-insensitive across username, email, firstName, lastName
  - Pagination and sorting support
- `GET /api/users/role/{roleName}` - Get users by role assignment
- `GET /api/users/department/{department}` - Get users by department
- `GET /api/users/status/{enabled}` - Get users by enabled/disabled status

**Account Management (2 APIs):**
- `PUT /api/users/{userId}/enabled/{enabled}` - Enable/disable user account
  - Disabled users cannot log in
  - Creates audit log entry
- `PUT /api/users/{userId}/locked/{locked}` - Lock/unlock user account
  - Locked users cannot authenticate
  - Automatic lockout after failed attempts
  - Manual unlock capability

**Role Assignment (2 APIs):**
- `POST /api/users/{userId}/roles/{roleId}` - Assign role to user
  - Supports multiple role assignments per user
  - Validates role existence
  - Creates audit trail
- `DELETE /api/users/{userId}/roles/{roleId}` - Remove role from user
  - Prevents last role removal
  - Updates user permissions immediately

**Analytics & Reporting (2 APIs):**
- `GET /api/users/statistics` - Comprehensive user statistics
  - Total users count
  - Enabled vs disabled breakdown
  - Locked accounts count
  - Active user percentage
  - Department distribution
  - Role assignment metrics

**User Entity Features:**
  - 17 comprehensive fields (core, profile, RBAC, security, audit)
  - Password excluded from all responses (security)
  - Account status tracking (enabled, locked, expired)
  - Failed login attempt counter
  - Last login timestamp and IP tracking
  - Multi-role support with permissions
  - Department and phone number support
  - Complete audit trail (created/updated by/at)

### 1️⃣8️⃣ Role & Permission Management - **NEW!** ⭐RBAC (14 APIs)
Industry-grade RBAC with granular permission control:

**Role CRUD Operations (5 APIs):**
- `POST /api/roles` - Create new role with permissions
  - Validates role name uniqueness
  - Supports permission assignment during creation
  - Creates audit trail
- `GET /api/roles/{roleId}` - Get role by ID (with permissions)
- `GET /api/roles/name/{name}` - Get role by name
- `PUT /api/roles/{roleId}` - Update role (description, permissions, status)
  - Partial updates supported
  - Cannot update role name (immutable)
- `DELETE /api/roles/{roleId}` - Delete role
  - System roles (ADMIN, USER, AUDITOR, OPERATOR) protected
  - Removes all user assignments
  - Creates audit log

**Role Search & Query (4 APIs):**
- `GET /api/roles` - Get all roles (paginated, sortable)
  - Default: 20 per page, sorted by name
  - Complete permission details included
- `GET /api/roles/search?searchTerm=` - Search roles by name/description
  - Case-insensitive search
  - Pagination support
- `GET /api/roles/status/{enabled}` - Get roles by enabled/disabled status
- `GET /api/roles/enabled` - Get all enabled roles (for dropdowns)
  - No pagination, optimized for UI selectors

**Role Status Management (1 API):**
- `PUT /api/roles/{roleId}/enabled/{enabled}` - Enable/disable role
  - Disabled roles cannot be assigned to users
  - Existing assignments remain but inactive

**Permission Management (3 APIs):**
- `POST /api/roles/{roleId}/permissions/{permission}` - Add single permission
  - Validates permission against available permissions
  - Immediate permission update
- `DELETE /api/roles/{roleId}/permissions/{permission}` - Remove permission
  - Updates all users with this role immediately
- `GET /api/roles/permissions` - Get all available system permissions
  - Returns complete permission catalog
  - Organized by category (certificates, users, roles, reports, etc.)

**Analytics & Reporting (1 API):**
- `GET /api/roles/statistics` - Comprehensive role statistics
  - Total roles count
  - System vs custom roles breakdown
  - Enabled vs disabled roles
  - Permission distribution metrics
  - User assignment statistics

**Available Permissions Categories:**
  - **Certificates:** CERT_READ, CERT_CREATE, CERT_UPDATE, CERT_DELETE, CERT_RENEW, CERT_REVOKE
  - **Certificate Authorities:** CA_READ, CA_CREATE, CA_UPDATE, CA_DELETE
  - **Users:** USER_READ, USER_CREATE, USER_UPDATE, USER_DELETE
  - **Roles:** ROLE_READ, ROLE_CREATE, ROLE_UPDATE, ROLE_DELETE
  - **Reports:** REPORT_READ, REPORT_GENERATE, REPORT_EXPORT
  - **Audit Logs:** AUDIT_READ, AUDIT_EXPORT
  - **System:** SYSTEM_ADMIN, SYSTEM_CONFIG
  - **Discovery:** DISCOVERY_READ, DISCOVERY_SCAN, DISCOVERY_SCHEDULE
  - **Alerts:** ALERT_READ, ALERT_CREATE, ALERT_UPDATE, ALERT_DELETE

**RBAC Features:**
  - Multi-role support per user
  - Granular permission-based access control
  - System role protection (cannot delete ADMIN, USER, etc.)
  - Dynamic permission assignment
  - Role enable/disable for temporary deactivation
  - Complete audit trail for all operations
  - Permission discovery and catalog
  - Department-based user organization

### 1️⃣9️⃣ Session Management - **NEW!** ⭐ENHANCED (3 APIs)
Track and manage user authentication sessions:
- `GET /api/sessions/active` - Get active sessions for current user (legacy)
- `GET /api/sessions/active/paginated` - **Get active sessions with pagination** ⭐ENHANCED
  - **Pagination support:** page, size parameters (default: 0, 10)
  - **Search:** search (username OR IP address, case-insensitive partial match)
  - **Filters:**
    - `userId` - Filter by specific user ID
    - `startDate` - Created after date (ISO-8601 format)
    - `endDate` - Created before date (ISO-8601 format)
  - **Sorting:** sortBy (createdAt, lastActivityAt, username, ipAddress), sortOrder (asc/desc)
  - **Default:** 10 per page, sorted by createdAt (descending)
  - **Returns:** Complete Page metadata with totalElements, totalPages, navigation
- `GET /api/sessions/my-sessions` - **Get my sessions with pagination** ⭐NEW
  - **Pagination support:** page, size parameters (default: 0, 20)
  - **Filters:**
    - `active` - Active status (true=active, false=inactive, null=all)
    - `startDate` - Created after date (ISO-8601 format)
    - `endDate` - Created before date (ISO-8601 format)
  - **Sorting:** sortBy (createdAt, lastActivityAt, active, expiresAt), sortOrder (asc/desc)
  - **Default:** 20 per page, sorted by createdAt (descending)
  - **Returns:** Both active and inactive sessions for authenticated user
  - **Use case:** View session history, manage multiple devices

**Session Features:**
  - Real-time active session tracking
  - Session history (active + inactive sessions)
  - Session token management
  - IP address and user agent logging
  - Last activity timestamp
  - Session expiration management
  - Multi-device session monitoring
  - Security analytics and anomaly detection

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Step 1: Authentication
Obtain a JWT token by logging in:
```bash
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"admin123"}'
```

### Step 2: Use the Token
Click the **Authorize** button above and enter:
```
Bearer {your-jwt-token-here}
```

### Step 3: Try the APIs
All endpoints below are now ready to use! Try the Dashboard endpoints first.

## 🔒 Authentication Details

- **Type:** JWT Bearer Token
- **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer {token}`
- **Token Expiration:** 24 hours
- **Default Credentials:** username: `admin`, password: `admin123`

- **Database:** H2 (dev), PostgreSQL (prod)
- **ORM:** Hibernate/JPA

Complete domain validation challenge to prove domain ownership. For HTTP-01: Place token at /.well-known/acme-challenge/{token}. For DNS-01: Create TXT record at _acme-challenge.{domain} with token value. For TLS-ALPN-01: Configure TLS server with validation certificate. After validation, ACME server automatically issues certificate. Certificate typically issued within minutes after successful validation.

Order certificate from ACME provider for specified domains. Supports single domain, multiple domains (SAN), and wildcard certificates (*.example.com). Returns order with validation challenges. Validation types: HTTP-01 (place file at http://domain/.well-known/acme-challenge/), DNS-01 (add TXT record _acme-challenge.domain), TLS-ALPN-01 (certificate-based validation). Order expires in 7 days. Complete validation within expiry to issue certificate.

Configure ACME (Automated Certificate Management Environment) protocol for automatic certificate issuance from providers like Let's Encrypt, ZeroSSL, or Buypass. Creates ACME account with email contact, generates account key pair, agrees to terms of service. Supports multiple ACME servers. Once configured, enables automated certificate ordering, domain validation, and issuance without manual CSR generation. Ideal for public-facing services requiring trusted, free certificates with 90-day validity.

get.description:
Retrieve comprehensive audit trail with pagination, sorting, and optional date filtering. **New in v2.0:** This endpoint now supports pagination for improved performance with large datasets. 

**Features:**
- **Pagination**: Efficiently handles millions of audit logs without memory issues
- **Sorting**: Sort by any field (timestamp, action, performedBy, etc.) in ascending/descending order
- **Date Filtering**: Optional date range filtering (inclusive)
- **Metadata**: Returns total count, page info, and navigation details

**Use Cases:**
- Security monitoring and compliance audits
- Troubleshooting and forensic analysis
- Activity tracking for specific users or time periods
- Export operations (iterate through pages)

**Each audit log entry includes:**
- Action performed (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, RENEW, REVOKE, etc.)
- Entity type and ID affected
- User who performed the action
- IP address and timestamp
- Before/after states for changes
- Status (success/failure) and error messages

**Example Requests:**
```
# First page with default settings (20 items, sorted by timestamp desc)
GET /api/audit-logs

# Second page with 50 items
GET /api/audit-logs?page=1&size=50

# Sort by action ascending
GET /api/audit-logs?sort=action,asc

# Multiple sort fields
GET /api/audit-logs?sort=performedBy,asc&sort=timestamp,desc

# Date range with pagination
GET /api/audit-logs?startDate=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z&endDate=2026-01-31T23:59:59Z&page=0&size=100
```

**Response Format:**
Returns Spring Data Page object with:
- `content`: Array of audit log entries
- `totalElements`: Total number of matching logs
- `totalPages`: Total number of pages
- `size`: Page size
- `number`: Current page number (0-indexed)
- `first`: Boolean indicating if this is the first page
- `last`: Boolean indicating if this is the last page
- `sort`: Current sort configuration

**Performance Notes:**
- Database-level pagination (efficient for any dataset size)
- Recommended page size: 20-100 items
- Maximum page size: 1000 items (configurable)
- Indexed on timestamp for fast date filtering

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date for filtering (ISO 8601 format, UTC timezone). Inclusive. Example: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. If provided, endDate must also be provided.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for filtering (ISO 8601 format, UTC timezone). Inclusive. Example: 2026-01-31T23:59:59Z. If provided, startDate must also be provided.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to retrieve (0-indexed). First page is 0, second page is 1, etc. Default: 0 (first page).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Recommended: 20-100. Maximum: 1000. Default: 20. Larger page sizes may impact performance.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort criteria in format: property,(asc|desc). Multiple sort criteria are supported. Default: timestamp,desc (newest first). 
Sortable fields: timestamp, action, performedBy, entityType, entityId, ipAddress. 
Examples: 
- timestamp,desc (newest first)
- timestamp,asc (oldest first)
- performedBy,asc&sort=timestamp,desc (by user, then by time)
- action,asc (by action type)

400.description: Invalid parameters (e.g., negative page number, invalid date format, page size exceeds maximum)

200.description: Paginated audit logs retrieved successfully. Returns Page<AuditLog> with metadata.

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions to view audit logs

401.description: Unauthorized - Bearer token missing or invalid

get.description: Returns ACME metrics for the past week. Convenient endpoint for weekly performance reviews and short-term trend analysis.
Provides aggregated statistics including total success rate, average response time, total orders processed, and failure analysis for the specified date range. Defaults to last 30 days.
Retrieves all metrics for a specific ACME provider (e.g., LETS_ENCRYPT, ZERO_SSL). Useful for comparing provider performance and identifying provider-specific issues.
Returns ACME metrics for the past month. Useful for monthly reporting and long-term trend analysis.
Identifies ACME operations with success rates below 80% or average response times exceeding 5 seconds. Helps administrators identify performance issues requiring attention.
Returns the most recent metrics snapshot for all ACME providers. Useful for real-time monitoring dashboards and getting current operational status.

Provides side-by-side comparison of all ACME providers including success rates, average response times, total orders, and reliability scores for the specified date range. Essential for provider selection and optimization.

Returns overall ACME system health including health score (0-100), status (healthy/degraded/unhealthy), active webhooks count, and problematic integrations. Use this endpoint for system health monitoring and alerting.
Provides a comprehensive dashboard overview including total orders, success rates, average processing time, health score (0-100), and provider-wise statistics. Essential for real-time monitoring.

get.summary: Get paginated ACME accounts with filters
get.description: Retrieves ACME accounts with pagination and optional filtering by provider and status. Both filters are optional - omit parameters to get all accounts. Accounts are linked to providers via acmeServerUrl matching the provider's directoryUrl. Common status values: VALID, DEACTIVATED, REVOKED. Example: /accounts/paginated?providerId=1&status=VALID&page=0&size=10

parameters.name: providerId
parameters.description: Provider ID to filter by (optional, filters by acmeServerUrl match)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Account status to filter by (optional, e.g., VALID, DEACTIVATED, REVOKED)

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort field (default: id, options: id, email, status, createdAt)

parameters.name: sortDir
parameters.description: Sort direction (default: ASC, options: ASC, DESC)
